articles.summary: After Israel Aerospace Industries sold an autonomous submarine to Germany, Elbit is also charging into the undersea world with the acquisition of a Canadian company. “Ukraine’s war against the Russian navy has changed the scene”, says Saar Koursh, head of Elbit’s naval systems sector. Are these the tools that will win the campaign in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb?
